items.title: 23 Points, 6-of-6 at the Line: Reese Scores 6 of Atlanta's 13 in OT
items.text: Her plus-11 was the best mark in the game. Free throws with 4.3 seconds left made it 101-98, and Atlanta leads 2-0.

items.title: A'ja Wilson Drops 38 as Aces Roll Past Fever in Game 1
items.text: A'ja Wilson scored 38 points with 16 rebounds as the No. 3 Aces beat the No. 6 Fever 102-85. Las Vegas leads the series 1-0 with Game 2 Tuesday in Indianapolis.

items.title: Aces vs. Fever Series Breakdown: A'ja Wilson Won the Matchup That Mattered
items.text: A'ja Wilson scored 96 points on 64.6% shooting as the Aces beat the Fever 2-1. Indiana won the paint in all three games.

items.title: Allisha Gray Is Out for Game 3 as the Dream Go for the Sweep in Brooklyn
items.text: Allisha Gray is out for Game 3. The Dream will try to sweep the Liberty without their leading scorer.

items.title: Angel Reese Won DPOY and Got Meaner: Her Game 1 Against the Liberty
items.text: Three days after winning DPOY, Angel Reese had four steals from four Liberty players in a 92-82 Dream win.

items.title: Bloody Teeth, No Whistle: The Caitlin Clark No-Call That Summed Up Fever vs. Aces
items.text: Caitlin Clark caught an elbow from Jewell Loyd with about three minutes left in Game 3. No foul was called. The Aces won 94-83.

items.title: Burton From 28, Stokes at the Rim: Valkyries Hold Off the Aces 83-81, Lead Semis 2-0
items.text: Vegas led for 11 seconds. Burton's 28-footer and Stokes's block gave the Valkyries an 83-81 win and a 2-0 lead.

items.title: Clark Hits Back-to-Back Threes, Fever Even Series with Aces
items.text: Caitlin Clark scored 27 points with 15 assists and Aliyah Boston had 22 as the Fever beat the Aces 99-89 to tie the series 1-1.

items.title: Dream Rally From 11 Down to Beat Mystics in Game 1
items.text: Rhyne Howard scored 26 with five steals, Angel Reese had 13 and 12 in her playoff debut, and the No. 4 Dream beat the No. 5 Mystics 92-77.

items.title: Hillmon Scores It, Ionescu Throws It Away: Dream Win Game 2 in OT, Lead 2-0
items.text: With 20.8 seconds left in overtime, Hillmon's layup made it 99-98. The Dream held on, 101-98, and lead the semis 2-0.

items.title: Johannes Hits the Dagger Three, Liberty Sweep the Lynx 87-71
items.text: Marine Johannes hit a 24-foot three, Jonquel Jones finished the and-one, and New York closed out an 87-71 sweep of the No. 1 Lynx.

items.title: JuJu Watkins' 1/1 Just Sold for $24,404: 10 Women's College Basketball Cards to Buy Before They Go Pro
items.text: Women's college basketball cards to buy before the WNBA. JuJu Watkins' 1/1 sold for $24,404 at Goldin, Sep 26, 2026 PT. Others on this list sold under $30.

items.title: Liberty Stun No. 1 Lynx 91-75: Game 1 Full Recap
items.text: Breanna Stewart had 34 points and 12 rebounds, Leonie Fiebich hit 4 of 5 threes, and the No. 8 Liberty beat the No. 1 Lynx 91-75 to take Game 1.

items.title: Ogunbowale Scores 45, Wings Beat Valkyries 108-100 in OT
items.text: Arike Ogunbowale scored 45 points, including the tying three with 4.1 seconds left, and the Wings beat the Valkyries 108-100 in overtime to tie the series 1-1.

items.title: Reese Takes It, Canada Buries It: Dream Grab Game 1 From the Liberty
items.text: With 1:30 left, Canada's step-back three made it 87-77. The Dream beat the Liberty 92-82 to lead 1-0.

items.title: Semis Game 3 Preview: Can the Liberty and Aces Do What No WNBA Team Has Done?
items.text: Teams up 2-0 in a best-of-five WNBA series are 19-0. Turnovers sink the Liberty, rebounds sink the Aces. Picks for both Game 3s on Friday.

items.title: This Is the Olympics of the WNBA
items.text: The league pauses as Team USA heads to Berlin with Caitlin Clark, Angel Reese, Paige Bueckers, A'ja Wilson and 58 combined All-Star selections.

items.title: Valkyries Blow Out Wings 104-80 in Game 1
items.text: Cecilia Zandalasini scored 22, Tiffany Hayes and Gabby Williams added 21 and 20, and the No. 2 Valkyries beat the No. 7 Wings 104-80 despite Paige Bueckers' 21.

items.title: Valkyries Close Out the Wings 77-73, Win Series 2-1
items.text: Dallas led 44-37 at half. Golden State won the fourth quarter 23-14, finished 77-73, and took the series 2-1.

items.title: Valkyries Own the Glass, Stun the Aces 71-60 in Semis Game 1
items.text: Golden State grabbed 52 rebounds to Vegas's 25 and beat the Aces 71-60 in Game 1. The glass leader did not score.

items.title: Wilson Scores 36, Aces Close Out the Fever 94-83
items.text: A'ja Wilson scored 36 points with 10 rebounds as the Aces beat the Fever 94-83 to win the first-round series 2-1.

items.title: WNBA Expansion Teams 2026: Portland Fire and Toronto Tempo
items.text: The WNBA has 15 teams in 2026. Here's how the Portland Fire and Toronto Tempo were built, how their first seasons went, and which new WNBA teams come next.
